snippet.title: Sort My Comics ! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Comics everywhere. It’s up to you to bring order back to the collection! Sort, shelve, complete your series, and unlock powers that gradually turn this gigantic mess into something wonderfully calming.
